programs.title: Naked and Afraid 6
programs.desc: Two unknown people, a woman and a man, are left in a lonely place with difficult climatic conditions.They must spend 21 days there without food, water or clothing.They can only take one item with them.Operators show how people relying on their own company learn to cooperate and make key decisions together.Viewers will see that appropriate knowledge and skills can be very useful in extreme moments and even determine survival.

programs.title: Woman at the end of the world
programs.desc: 90% of Koreans use the Internet, almost all of them do it every day.There they follow vloggers who play online games, or muk-bang, i.e. people eating in front of the camera.Online users also adopt virtual children or see the world from a cat's perspective.However, greater activity on the Internet is related to the real, deepening loneliness of Koreans.The heroine of the episode will be BJ Levi, who reports her life on the Internet - she is Muk-bang and she makes money from it.In Korean, the word "family" means people who eat together.It is generally accepted that no one should eat a meal alone.On the other hand, nowadays more and more people live away from their families, so BJe provide them with company.The best of them can earn up to $9-10,000 a month, which is two or three times more than corporate employees.The most popular ones gain the status of celebrities.

programs.title: Woman at the end of the world
programs.desc: Martyna Wojciechowska visits Tanzania.The traveler will look at the tradition according to which a woman can marry another woman.However, this is not related to homosexuality, which is banned in this country.Sexual acts between people of the same sex are punishable by imprisonment.The first case of a relationship between two women in Tanzania was recorded in 1927.For the Kuria tribe, children, especially boys, are the most valuable.So when a woman is, for example, infertile, she must marry another woman to give her children.As in the case of male-female relationships, the partner is paid in cows.Depending on the amount of wealth owned, there may be several wives.Relationships between women constitute 10-15% of all marriages.They live together, do housework and raise children together.

programs.title: Woman at the end of the world
programs.desc: The eighth season is a special time in Martyna Wojciechowska's life.Due to numerous adversities, she was unable to complete the full series of the program.It may not have been broadcast either.However, the traveler managed to visit five extraordinary women.She had a special bond with Maja, who lives in Florida.In Russia, thanks to Larisa Renar, Martyna Wojciechowska learned the secret of sex appeal.She visited women and their wives in picturesque Tanzania.However, in South Korea, thanks to BJ Levi, almost an episode from the past was created.The traveler also touched upon the difficult issue of trafficking in women and sexual exploitation of minors.Back then, the heroine of the report was Iana Matei from Romania, for whom the lives of children became more important than her own.In addition, she will also visit Kabula, an albino girl, to check how she is doing in her new school and whether she is fulfilling her dreams.

programs.title: Man, Woman, Wild
programs.desc: In the program, a married couple takes up the challenge and tries to survive in the wilderness.Mykel Hawke is an expert in the US Army Special Forces Survival School, and his wife Ruth is a television journalist.We will meet them in the most remote and dangerous corners of the world, where they will have to survive for four days with only a knife.This is one of the most difficult exams that will test not only their resilience, but also the durability of their marriage in extreme situations.Mykel was taught how to survive in any conditions.However, for Ruth, encounters with wildlife are a completely new experience.A man will have to teach his wife how to build a roof over her head and how to look for food.
